description: Answer “how is campaign X doing”: campaign performance, native optimization results, status, budgets, issues and bounded ad set learning counts. Use ads_query_insights for custom analysis. Result indicators and attribution windows stay separate. Reporting 429 responses carry Retry-After. ROW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED means wait until meta.quota.resetsAt (or the error quota reset); do not retry before then.

after.description: Opaque paging.after cursor. Keep filters unchanged.

datePreset.description: Named Meta date preset. Mutually exclusive with timeRange. Defaults to last_30d when neither date option is supplied.

timeRange.description: Explicit current date range, mutually exclusive with datePreset. Use compare for a previous period, previous year or custom range.

since.description: Inclusive range start in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.

until.description: Inclusive range end in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.
